create_moonshine_streaming_processor: create a MoonshineStreamingProcessor instance with a feature extractor and tokenizer for audio-text processing
call_processor_with_audio: call the MoonshineStreamingProcessor with audio input to extract feature inputs for the model
call_processor_with_text: call the MoonshineStreamingProcessor with text input to tokenize and encode text for the model
call_processor_with_audio_and_text: call the MoonshineStreamingProcessor with both audio and text to produce features with labels for training
pad_processor_batch: pad a batch of input features and labels using the MoonshineStreamingProcessor pad method
get_model_input_names: get the model input names from the MoonshineStreamingProcessor combining feature extractor names and labels
